purpose: PPO pipeline performance diagnosis; the loaded checkpoint is updated only in memory and is never saved

ipc_timing_methodology.request_serialization: ForkingPickler serialization of the exact policy request tuple before queue submission
ipc_timing_methodology.request_send: elapsed from serialized-envelope queue submission timestamp until the central process dequeues the envelope
ipc_timing_methodology.response_wait: elapsed from central request dequeue until the worker receives the matching policy action
ipc_timing_methodology.aggregation: seconds are summed across concurrent workers; per-request means and accounted fraction are the comparable diagnostics

central_timing_methodology.queue_to_batch: per-request elapsed from central queue dequeue to the timestamp at which its inference batch is closed
central_timing_methodology.cpu_input: separate NumPy stack allocation, CPU tensor views/dtype conversion, copied bytes, and hidden-state concatenation
central_timing_methodology.cuda_components: CUDA events split H2D, Transformer, GRU, policy/value heads, masked distribution, and D2H; diagnostic synchronization is enabled only by --profile-central-timing
central_timing_methodology.gpu_busy_vs_worker_wait: GPU busy is the sum of profiled CUDA-event stages; worker wait is central blocking for worker messages plus configured batch-formation wait. The ratio is diagnostic, not system GPU utilization.
